# Change: descriptive name

Status: proposed | implemented | superseded

## Problem and evidence

Describe the concrete trigger and the observed behavior. Link the source,
counterexample, issue or reproducible run. Distinguish observation from inference.

## Behavior contract

State the desired observable result, inputs, outputs and relevant constraints.
Name what makes an answer correct and which cases must remain supported.

## Approach and scope

Name the affected components and the relevant knowledge topics/primary sources.
Record material trade-offs and experimental flags. Keep routine details in code.

## Verification

List meaningful checks and acceptance conditions, including a negative control
where appropriate. Distinguish offline mechanics from live model quality and cost.
After implementation, record the actual result and remaining uncertainty.

## Knowledge maintenance

Update the affected topic, review it against changed sources, stamp its source
fingerprints and run the catalog check. Link the implementation/PR when available.
